admission.justification: The answer of a call that delivers held messages is one testable promise, and the case witnesses it through the response model.

applicability: Every delivery answer, including a call that delivers held messages together with its own.
conditions: The answer carries the delivery status of the message the call sent.
exclusions: No validation error follows a delivery.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_paseo_role_messages.py::RoleMessageTests::test_a_delivery_that_takes_held_messages_answers_ok ('turnId' unexpectedly found on the base, RoleMessageResponse.model_validate accepts it on the candidate); report role-reports/worker/8500ba4e-39b3-5373-8e2d-cfe91a38af4c/role-launch/260928-MIK-L171-worker-8500ba4e-39b3-5373-8e2d-cfe91a38af4c.md

statement: A delivery that carried held messages with it answers as a delivery the response model accepts, carrying no turn id, while the turn id stays available to a waiting caller.
